instructions:
1. Sit on a bench with feet flat on the floor.
2. Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
3. Rest your forearms on your thighs so your wrists hang just past your knees.
4. Lower the dumbbells by letting your wrists drop down.
5. Raise the dumbbells by extending your wrists upward as far as possible.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and avoid swinging the weight.
2. Keep your forearms pressed flat against your thighs.
3. Exhale as you raise, inhale as you lower.
4. Use a light weight to feel the extensors work.
name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl

instructions:
1. Stand with feet hip-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your thighs.
2. Keep a slight bend in your knees and a neutral spine.
3. Hinge at the hips and push your hips back, lowering the dumbbells down the front of your legs.
4. Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, around knee level.
5. Drive your hips forward to stand back up.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Hinge at the hips, do not round your lower back.
2. Keep the dumbbells close to your legs throughout.
3. Keep a slight, fixed bend in your knees.
4. Exhale as you stand up, inhale as you lower.
name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift

instructions:
1. Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet lifted off the ground.
2. Hold a dumbbell with both hands at chest level.
3. Lean back slightly to form a V-shape with your torso and thighs.
4. Rotate your torso to the right, bringing the dumbbell beside your hip.
5. Return to center, then rotate to the left.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your spine straight, do not round your back.
2. Move with control instead of using momentum.
3. Keep your feet steady and legs together.
4. Exhale on each twist.
name: Dumbbell Russian Twist with Legs Floor Off

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
2. Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees with upper arms near parallel to the floor.
3. Swing the dumbbells outward and up in an arc until your arms extend just above shoulder height.
4. Reverse the arc to bring the dumbbells back in front of your face.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lead with your elbows out to the sides to hit the lateral delts.
2. Keep your wrists straight and in line with your forearms.
3. Use a light weight and high reps to control the arc.
4. Exhale as you press out and up.
name: Dumbbell Scott Press

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
2. Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees with upper arms near parallel to the floor.
3. Swing the dumbbells outward and up in a wide arc until your arms extend just above shoulder height.
4. Reverse the full arc to return the dumbbells to the front of your face.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Trace a wide, smooth arc to keep tension on the delts.
2. Lead with the elbows out to the sides.
3. Keep your wrists straight and aligned with your forearms.
4. Use a light weight to control the full path.
name: Dumbbell Scott Press (360 degrees)
